description: Draft a job contract for an AI agent from a template (support_triage, sdr_qualification, internal_assistant, coding_patch): objective, unit of work, acceptance criteria, budget, the human baseline for ROI, and optional vendor terms (vendor_name, billable_unit, and the vendor's own definition of resolved, carried verbatim and labelled the vendor's definition, not verified). Returns the draft to publish plus validation errors and warnings. A pure function over your input: reads nothing, stores nothing, needs no key. Publishing the draft is a separate step (set_job_contract, 'admin' scope).

agent_key.description: The agent the contract will be published for (informational in the draft).

billable_unit.description: What the vendor bills per, in the vendor's words, e.g. 'resolution' or 'conversation'.

human_baseline.description: What the same unit costs when a person does it; the ROI comparison needs it.

basis.description: Where the baseline number comes from.

owner.description: The person accountable for this agent (name or email).

template.description: Which job template to start from.

unit_of_work.description: What one unit is, e.g. 'resolved ticket'.

vendor_name.description: Who you pay for the agent’s work (the AI vendor).

vendor_resolved_definition.description: The vendor's own definition of "resolved", word for word. Kept unchanged and shown as the vendor's definition, not verified.

workload.description: Defaults to agent_key, else the template key.

name: metrx_draft_job_contract
title: Draft Job Contract
